+Set `post_damping_reject=1` to validate the final damped candidate before commit.
+The default is `0`, retaining the parent behavior. Other values are rejected.
+With the option enabled, the FP32 primitive kernel marks every failed physical
+cell using stage bit8. Its guard excludes earlier failed stages while allowing
+all threads in the current stage to finish collecting failures. Ordered default
+stream kernels complete this check before the CFL reduction and host summary.
+An invalid candidate restores the entire pre-first-damping U_n, leaves the cached
+CFL unchanged, and returns false to the existing local repair, first-order
+escape and timestep-halving policy. Probes, accepted counters and state swaps
+occur only after acceptance. No pressure floor, energy repair, tolerance change
+or equation change is introduced.

+`post_damping_rejection.json` records `enabled`, `rejected_attempts`, `stage_bit`,
+`rollback`, `damping_arithmetic_unchanged`, `no_state_floors`, and `by_day` keyed
+by integer physical UTC day. Counts are failed attempts, so multiple entries can
+belong to one eventual accepted step. These attempts also enter the existing
+rejected-step and repair ledgers. The report is written on each such rejection
+and at normal completion, preserving counts even if a later attempt fails.
+
+`build_postdamp_reject.py` generates the separate FP32, GPU64-reference and CPU64
+sources and SHA256 lineage. The CPU implementation saves the pre-final-damping
+inventory locally, validates the damped candidate, and commits the accepted RK
+and integrated induction-source ledgers only on success. Attempted RHS counts
+retain rejected work explicitly. The existing RK audit measures the update
+between the two half-damping operations; its key alone is not a cumulative
+energy budget including both damping losses.
+

+latitude−31.875°. Its pre-damping pressure was 7.45058e−9 in FP32; final damping

+is final-subtraction roundoff in a very cold candidate. The old, candidate and
+post-damping states, thermal values and frozen failed-run receipt hashes are in
+`validation/janhunen_postdamp/`. This fixes acceptance semantics, and establishes
+no accuracy claim for such extremely small thermal energies.
+
+`implementation_gates.json` records the bounded gates. The frozen parent,
+default-off derivative and enabled derivative have identical physical outputs,

+The original long GPU64 startup and a duplicate early96 derivative startup were

+their partial logs and explicit cancellation receipts remain. Neither is a

def comet_velocity(day):
    ephemeris = np.genfromtxt(ROOT/"observations/ephemeris_comet.tsv", delimiter="\t", names=True)
    basis = np.array(json.loads((ROOT/"observations/coordinate_system.json").read_text())["ecliptic_to_solar_equatorial_matrix"])
    xyz = np.array([np.interp(day+60980, ephemeris["mjd_utc"], ephemeris[k]) for k in ["x_au", "y_au", "z_au"]]).T@basis.T
    vel = np.array([np.interp(day+60980, ephemeris["mjd_utc"], ephemeris[k]) for k in ["vx_au_day", "vy_au_day", "vz_au_day"]]).T@basis.T*149597870.7/86400

    theta, phi = np.arccos(xyz[:,2]/radius), np.arctan2(xyz[:,1],xyz[:,0])
    er = xyz/radius[:,None]

    ep = np.array([-np.sin(phi), np.cos(phi), np.zeros_like(phi)]).T

def weighted_mean(t, values, intervals):
